title: RESOURCE_SPEC v3
description: Cloud coordinates and an explicit Docker-on-VM deployment topology. The topology records placement and ingress structure without making an availability or SLA claim.

provider.description: Cloud provider selected before design starts.

region.description: Resolved provider region code, such as ap-northeast-2.

regionAsWritten.description: Original region expression supplied by the user.

deploymentTargets.description: Provider-specific deployment alternatives selected by the user. The compatibility provider and region fields identify the first candidate only; downstream code must not silently discard the remaining alternatives.

monthlyBudgetUSD.description: Monthly infrastructure budget normalized to USD.

minVCpu.description: User- or designer-supplied minimum vCPU floor. It may be collected during requirements feedback.

minMemoryGiB.description: User- or designer-supplied minimum memory floor in GiB. It may be collected during requirements feedback.

computeProfile.description: Finite app-compute topology family. It describes lifecycle control, replica multiplicity, and occupied-zone layout without claiming availability.

replicaCount.description: Exact fixed app replica count. Autoscaling is outside v1.

publicIngress.description: Public HTTP ingress realization. standaloneOne requires direct; managed groups require loadBalanced. HTTPS/TLS is outside v1.

databasePlacement.description: Self-hosted PostgreSQL placement. Colocated is valid only for standaloneOne; dedicated uses one private state VM and a separate persistent disk.

applicationStateless.description: Evidence gate for more than one app replica; true means local sessions, uploads, singleton schedulers, and writable local state are absent or externalized.

scale.description: Optional expected load magnitude; it does not determine a VM size by itself.
